controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-12T20:06:42.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:06:42.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
        AND user.name IS NULL
| STATS count = COUNT(*)
        BY message
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 10
